name: INSPIRE Awards – MANAK (Million Minds Augmenting National Aspirations and Knowledge)
briefDescription: This central scheme motivates students aged 10-15 (Classes 6-10) to develop one million science and societal innovations, fostering creativity and innovation in schools.
descriptionMd: The INSPIRE Awards – MANAK scheme is a central initiative designed to motivate students across India. It aims to encourage young minds, specifically those in classes 6 to 10 and aged 10-15 years, to explore and develop original ideas and innovations. The core purpose is to cultivate a strong culture of scientific creativity and innovative thinking among school children by targeting one million such ideas.
benefitsMd:
- Motivates students to develop original scientific and socially relevant ideas.
- Fosters a culture of creativity and innovative thinking among school children.
- Aims to generate one million new ideas/innovations from young minds.
eligibilityMd:
- Student must be in the age group of 10-15 years.
- Student must be studying in classes 6 to 10.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
